title: Fixed Size Array - QOL
description:
---
Congrats! One thing left before you finish your first _real datastructure!_. We are going to add 3 new simple methods. `T& front()`, which returns a ref to the first element of the array, `T& back()`, which returns a ref to the final element of the array, and finally, `T* get_data()`, which returns data. For all these methods they should have a const return and the function itself should be const.
